Westside Auto Wholesale, a family-run private company, is the leading West Australian used car dealership and is home to the largest vehicle range in Australia. They have been awarded one of eight Most Loved Australian Business Award by Podium in Perth. They are also global award winners in Customer Experience, Dealership of the Year and Most Love Local businesses.

We are seeking highly skilled and experienced Motor Mechanic to join and work with our team of hardworking professionals who share a common drive to make a difference in the industry.

The role includes but is not limited to:
Conduct regular repair, test, and maintenance services such as oil change, lubrications, and engine tune-ups of motor vehicles, machinery, and other mechanical components
Create a plan of action for all maintenance tasks and upgrades
Meet with clients to better understand their concerns and identify the issue
Provide high-quality service to clients to help them identify, repair, and avert issues that may affect the performance or longevity of their motor vehicles
Generate timelines and estimates for repairs, discussing options with clients.
Detect and diagnose faults in engines and parts
Disassemble/assemble mechanical components according to specifications.
Repair or replace worn, old or defective parts of motor vehicles, ensuring replaced parts are checked and tested using proper testing equipment
Examine machines and oversee diagnostic tests to determine functionality problems.
Maintain and document work logs, repairs, and maintenance records.
Monitor inventory and order new parts when necessary.
Suggest/Propose maintenance and preventative procedures to machine and vehicle users.

To be considered for this role, you must have:
Trade qualification or Equivalent
Solid experience in a similar role
Proven ability to diagnose and repair vehicles and follow safety instructions and directions.
Analytical, keen to help our clients resolve issues with vehicle performance and appearance
Proficient with mechanic’s tools and other diagnostic equipment.
Physically and mentally fit
Strong attention to details and diagnostic abilities
Strong communications and reporting skills
Customer service skills
Ability to work well both independently and in a team environment
Self-motivated, organised, and reliable with strong work ethic

If you meet the above criteria and would like to be considered for this position, please apply now!
Salary: Between $79,499 and $82,000 per annum + Super

Job Description: 
Required a results-driven Senior Data Engineer with experience in designing, developing, and delivering enterprise-scale data engineering solutions across data warehousing, big data, and cloud platforms.

Key Responsibilities & Leadership -
•	Design and implement enterprise-scale data architectures, including Data Warehouses and Data Lakes.
•	Build and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines for analytics, reporting, and operational workloads.
•	Lead end-to-end data migration and modernisation programs from legacy systems to Hadoop, Spark, Databricks, and AWS platforms using Agile methodology.
•	Define and execute migration strategies, including data analysis, mapping, transformation, integration, validation, reconciliation, and production deployment.
•	Design and optimise data models, SQL queries, and Spark workloads to improve performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.
•	Develop automation solutions to reduce manual effort and improve operational efficiency.
•	Ensure data quality, consistency, governance, and compliance across enterprise data platforms.
•	Perform data profiling, validation, and reconciliation to ensure accuracy and reliability of data assets.
•	Lead technical design reviews, architecture discussions, and code reviews to ensure adherence to best practices and standards.
•	Manage full project lifecycle delivery, including requirements gathering, design, development, testing, deployment, and production support.
•	Collaborate with architects, business analysts, product owners, and clients to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
•	Lead and mentor data engineering teams, including task allocation, skill development, and performance management.
•	Identify and resolve technical and delivery blockers to ensure timely project execution.
•	Manage stakeholder expectations and communicate technical solutions clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
•	Deliver both new development and production support projects in enterprise environments.
•	Continuously improve systems by identifying opportunities for performance, scalability, and cost optimisation.
•	Adapt quickly to new technologies, including AI-enabled data platforms, modern data engineering tools, and evolving coding methodologies.
•	Apply modern coding practices, including modular design, reusable components, version control standards, and CI/CD-aligned development approaches.
•	Maintain a strong continuous learning mindset and ability to work across evolving data and AI-driven ecosystems.
•	Strong domain expertise in banking domain.
Technical Skills -
•	Data Engineering & Platforms:  Data Warehousing, Data Lakes, ETL/ELT, Data Pipelines, Data Modelling, Data Profiling, Data Migration, Data Modernisation, Data Quality, Data Governance
•	Databases: SQL, Teradata, Oracle, DB2, Vertica, PostgreSQL, Amazon Redshift
•	Big Data Technologies: Hadoop ecosystem (HDFS, Hive, Hive SQL), Apache Spark, Spark SQL, PySpark
•	Cloud & Modern Data Platforms: AWS/Azure/GCP, Databricks/Snowflake/DBT
•	Programming & Scripting: Python, UNIX Shell Scripting
•	CI/CD: GitHub/ Jenkins

Your Opportunity
We are seeking talented individuals to join our External Audit practise at KPMG.  We are open to full-time/part-time/casual/max-term/flexible working options.

IT External Audit
Our IT External Audit team assists our clients to meet their IT External audit requirements and timelines. We work as an integrated business and as part of a larger multi-disciplinary team. The team draws on a diverse and dedicated group of people, powerful KPMG methodologies, innovating capability and assets, and global resources to support our clients in achieving the right milestones. 

Audit & Assurance: External Audit
Our Audit teams provide value to our clients by delivering specialised quality audit and assurance services. High-quality, independent financial statement audits are essential to maintaining investor confidence. Our audit professionals are committed to the public interest, challenging assumptions, and unlocking valuable insights based on a solid understanding of an organisation’s business and industry.

How are you extraordinary?
•	You are analytically minded and enjoy applying structured thinking and analysis techniques to complex problems. 
•	You are a kind and compassionate leader with a passion for continually growing your leadership skills to get the best out of a diverse and multidisciplinary team.
•	You are a people-person with a love of sharing your Audit and Assurance insight and tailoring your communication appropriately for subject matter experts and clients who want to learn more.

Your Experience
To be considered for this opportunity, your qualifications, skills & experience could include:

IT External Audit
•	Experience in assisting clients meet their IT External audit requirements and timelines.
•	Supporting engagements in the preparation of clear and concise IT External Audit reports. 
•	Providing technical knowledge, direction, and training to engagement team members.
•	In a leadership role, manage small teams and oversee the planning and execution of IT External Audit client engagements
•	Supporting business proposals and business development activities by assisting in the identification of new target clients, building business relationships, and developing/presenting proposals/findings
•	An innovative mindset and passion for problem solving enabled through technology.

Audit & Assurance: External Audit
•	Experience leading, managing and executing advisory related engagements of high-profile clients and all aspects of audit delivery, client service and business development.
•	Providing technical knowledge, direction, and training to engagement team members.
•	Experience working across Private and Corporate clients is desired.
•	Qualifications in CA/CPA and CISA/CISM/CRISC, and strong IFRS skills, will be viewed favourably.

Please note, the salary ranges $60k - $100k+ with respect to your level of experience.

result.description:
Akkurat Pty Ltd is an automation machinery manufacturer based in Brendale, Queensland that provides services to a vast range of industries including Oil and Gas, Renewable Energy, Coal Mining, and Coal Seam Gas. Akkurat Pty Ltd is currently seeking a full time, qualified Instrumentation Technician (Electronic Instrument Trades Worker).
The salary offered is $120,000 per annum plus superannuation.
Job duties and responsibilities include:
• Installing, modifying, maintaining, and repairing electronic instruments and control systems for clients across industries such as Oil and Gas, Renewable Energy, Coal Mining, and Coal Seam Gas.
• Examining and testing machines, equipment, instruments, and control systems to diagnose faults.
• Adjusting, repairing, and replacing worn and defective parts and wiring, and maintaining machines, equipment, and instruments.
• Reassembling, test operating and adjusting equipment.
• Advising users of correct operating procedures to prevent malfunctions.
• Receiving messages by interpreting code and converting to plain language and writing and typing messages for transmission.
• Monitoring radio traffic and transmitting and receiving voice messages.
• Installing electronic instruments and control systems.
• Applying knowledge of electrical, electronic, mechanical, hydraulic, and pneumatic principles in commissioning and maintaining control systems.
• Ensuring overall electrical compliance and completing relevant documentation and checklists.
• Compliance with dossiers, FAT testing and troubleshooting, and assisting workshop and field staff.
• Abide by workplace health and safety policies and procedures.

The applicant will have the following skills and experience:

• At least an AQF Certificate III and two years of relevant work experience, or an AQF Certificate IV.
• At least 3 years of relevant work experience may substitute formal qualifications.
• Knowledge and experience in electrical and instrumentation compliance.
• Attentive to work and self-driven to solve problems.
• Ability to work collaboratively and independently.
• Vision and leadership.
